_fixture_meta.description: Valet status captured live on the reporter's own Hyundai Santa Fe HEV (2026-11-01) via lib PR #1331 design probe. valetMode is an int enum: the app (myHyundai 1.4.0, CCS SDK lib-domain ValetMode) defines ACTIVE(0), IGN_OFF(1), INACTIVE(2), INVALID(-1). This capture shows INACTIVE(2). The active-state values are unit-tested from the enum source and await a live flip on an outdoor car; a CA-app demo asset shows the same field carrying an extended active shape (startDate/endDateTime/runTime blocks) plus currentLocation, so the parser reads only valetMode and leaves the rest alone.
